server: llama-server of llama.cpp build 12375 (commit 9d25e0014), the image's /app/llama-server, on CPU with 4 threads, a context of 4096 tokens and 4 slots, the port published on the loopback address only
workload: the model stories15M-q4_0.gguf (sha256 66967fbece6dbe97886593fdbb73589584927e29119ec31f08090732d1861739) from https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/models/resolve/main/tinyllamas/stories15M-q4_0.gguf, a conversion of https://huggingface.co/karpathy/tinyllamas (MIT licence), served under the name stories15M; the model is not part of the repository
command: aiperf profile --url http://127.0.0.1:8000 --model stories15M --endpoint-type chat --streaming --request-rate 2 --arrival-pattern constant --benchmark-duration 10 --isl 32 --osl 32 --tokenizer gpt2 --random-seed 1234 --artifact-dir out/r2 --export-level records --ui none --no-gpu-telemetry --no-server-metrics
replaced: every one of the 19 records kept; per record metadata kept to session_num, turn_index, request_start_ns, request_end_ns, benchmark_phase, was_cancelled (ids and worker names dropped) and metrics to time_to_first_token, inter_token_latency, request_latency, input_sequence_length, output_sequence_length, output_token_count; every clock reading moved by a whole number of seconds so that the run starts at 1000000000 s since the epoch (the time between two readings is kept)
tool_install: aiperf 0.13.0 from PyPI, run on the host beside the server
